# CartoBoost

CartoBoost is a Python toolkit for structured regression, classification,
ranking, and forecasting. Use the docs to choose the right model family, then
compare it against strong baselines on the same split.

## Primary Docs

- README: ./README.md
- Docs home: ./docs/index.md
- Getting started: ./docs/getting-started.md
- Choose a model: ./docs/user-guide/model-types.md
- Boosting model guides: ./docs/user-guide/boosting-models/index.md
- Forecasting model guides: ./docs/user-guide/forecasting-models/index.md
- Graph model guides: ./docs/user-guide/graph-models/index.md
- Neural model guides: ./docs/user-guide/neural-models/index.md
- Forecasting reference: ./docs/forecasting.md
- Graph features contract: ./docs/graph-features.md
- Neural features contract: ./docs/neural-features.md
- Benchmarks: ./docs/benchmarks/index.md
- Model benchmark suite: ./docs/benchmarks/model-suite.md
- NYC taxi benchmark report: ./docs/benchmarks/nyc-taxi.md

## Public Surfaces

- `cartoboost.CartoBoostRegressor`
- `cartoboost.CartoBoostClassifier`
- `cartoboost.CartoBoostRanker`
- `cartoboost.forecasting.*`
- `cartoboost.graph.*`
- `cartoboost.neural.*`
- `cartoboost.plotting`

## Usage Notes

- Keep public docs focused on what each model family is good for, not on
  implementation details.
- Use taxi examples only as one domain example among others such as mobility,
  routing, logistics, and demand forecasting.
- Keep benchmark claims tied to maintained artifacts, exact commands, and
  comparable baselines.
